And the first understanding we don't have agency. We don't really control because there are powerful gods out there. Like Apollo and Dianesis, but they too are controlled by even more powerful forces such as fate and fortune, or ancient gods controlling the universe's structure. So, you absolutely have no individual agency because there’s always a god screwing with you.

You might get rich, but then the god of pride looks at you and says, "No, no, no. I need to teach this more a lesson." The god comes into me, makes me too arrogant, and I screw up. So we're always being controlled by these forces beyond our understanding.

The second world view is that we are synapses generating memories, and thus our understanding of the world comes from experience controlled by synapses formed from DNA and environment. This means you can have control over your own individual fate through therapy, reflection, and exercises.

In the first world view, there are many gods who are evil, random, and we have no control over our fate. We can only hope to get lucky in life and not piss off the gods. In the second world view, we are a collection of memories and synapses. Proper manipulation of these can make us free from anger, depression, misery.

Which world view is a more accurate reflection of reality? The first one, because it gives you a more accurate assessment of how the world really works. So now, if powerful people prefer the second worldview, what are the benefits?

The first benefit is individual responsibility and more control, making it easier to control people in the system. The second benefit is that you'll work harder because in the first system, working hard isn't necessary since the gods might punish you for wealth.

There's also a powerlessness factor. This system is designed to make you absolutely powerless because everything is controlled by gods and faith.
